live_ar.privacy: Camera stays on your device; nothing is recorded or uploaded. Starting downloads body and hand tracking from jsDelivr and Google. Experimental silhouette sizing and hand occlusion; no cloth simulation. Visual preview only, not a fit measurement.
live_ar.permission: Choose Start camera, then allow camera access. Include your shoulders and hips in view.
live_ar.loading: Loading garment and on-device tracking. Please wait.
live_ar.body_missing: Step back until both shoulders and hips are visible. Face the camera in good light.
live_ar.tracking: Live preview active. Face forward and move slowly.
live_ar.denied: Camera blocked. Allow access in browser settings, then restart the camera.
live_ar.unsupported: Live AR needs HTTPS and camera support. Try Safari or Chrome, or use photo try-on.
live_ar.runtime_error: Preview could not load or continue. Check your connection, close other camera apps and restart the camera.
live_ar.paused: Camera stopped while this page was in the background. Choose Start camera to resume.
live_ar.variant_unavailable: This option is unavailable. Choose another option or return to the product page.
live_ar.cart_error: Could not add this item. Check your connection and try again.
live_ar.added: Added to your cart. Continue your preview or choose View cart.
live_ar.setup: Live AR: select a product, transparent garment image and supported variant IDs. Map only variants matching the garment and color.
live_ar.demo: Sample jackets · preview only, not for purchase
live_ar.qr_instructions: Scan this code with your phone camera and open the link. The selected jacket opens on your phone. Tap Start camera, allow access, and step back until your shoulders and hips are visible.
live_ar.qr_privacy: Try-on runs on your phone. Camera video is not sent to this computer. Your phone has its own cart. A password-protected store may ask you to unlock it first.
live_ar.qr_alt: Scan to open this jacket in mobile try-on
live_ar.qr_unavailable: Phone handoff needs a public HTTPS storefront page. Open the Shopify storefront preview in a separate tab to create a scannable code. A localhost address works only on this computer.
live_ar.qr_error: Could not create the phone code. Check your connection and try again.
live_ar.asset_error: The jacket image could not load. Reload this storefront preview, then restart the camera.
live_ar.camera_error: The camera stopped or could not start. Check camera access and close other camera apps, then retry.
live_ar.module_error: The preview software could not download. Check your connection and reload this page.
live_ar.model_error: Body tracking could not initialize. Check your connection, reload the page and retry.
live_ar.frame_error: Body tracking stopped while reading a camera frame. Restart the camera. If this repeats, reload the page.
live_ar.arms_missing: Bring your elbows and wrists into view for sleeve alignment. Face forward and keep your arms apart.
